[SWS_CM_10415] Notify the Field value after a call to the SetHandler function
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00218
⌈
The Communication Management implementation shall take the effective
field
value returned by the
SetHandler
function, and send it back to the requester as
return value of the
Set()
function (see [SWS_CM_00113]), and to all the other sub-
scribed entities via notification (see [SWS_CM_00119]).
⌋
